subject: E-Commerce
title: Cross-Border Returns Nightmare
description: Learn Cross-Border Returns Nightmare in one minute.

hook.text: Returning a cross-border purchase costs the customer $20-40 on average. Most buyers keep the item & leave a bad review.

buildup.text: International returns require customs forms, international postage, and 2-4 weeks of waiting for refunds.

discovery.text: Some sellers offer 'returnless refunds'—they refund the money and tell the buyer to keep or donate the product.

twist.text: Returnless refunds attract fraud. Some buyers claim items are defective to get free products repeatedly.

climax.text: Cross-border returns remain largely unsolved. The cost of shipping back often exceeds the product's value.

punchline.text: Cross-Border Returns Nightmare: the goal is not certainty, but sharper thinking.

quiz.question: Why do many cross-border sellers offer returnless refunds?
options: The cost of international return shipping often exceeds the product value
